content.value_statement: AI content can flatten distinct Indigenous cultures or misuse protected traditions. This skill reviews text and image prompts using rights-based frameworks and practical red flags.
actual_capabilities: Identifies unspecified or mixed Indigenous cultural references before content generation.
Reviews text and image prompts for stereotypes, historical distortion, restricted content, and unauthorized commercial use.
Classifies requests as pass, revise, or refuse and explains the decision.
Applies CARE, OCAP, UNDRIP, Local Contexts labels, and Taiwan legal references.
Suggests safer alternatives and context requirements for sensitive requests.
limitations: Does not represent any Indigenous nation, community, or official authority.
Does not grant legal permission or replace community consent.
Covers Taiwan-specific groups in detail but offers less local detail for other regions.
Cannot verify whether cultural material is restricted without authoritative community sources.

use_cases.title: Review Educational Materials
use_cases.description: Check lessons and articles for cultural specificity, current context, respectful language, and responsible sourcing.

use_cases.title: Assess Creative Prompts
use_cases.description: Evaluate image or writing prompts before generation and replace stereotypes with specific, documented context.

use_cases.title: Screen Commercial Concepts
use_cases.description: Identify consent, attribution, protected knowledge, and community benefit concerns before using cultural elements in products.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Text Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this text for respectful treatment of Indigenous cultures: [text]. Identify the named community, red flags, decision, and required revisions.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused review of a short draft.

prompt_templates.title: Image Prompt Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this image prompt: [prompt]. Check specificity, mixed traditions, stereotypes, restricted elements, current context, and attribution. Provide a revision when appropriate.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creator wants to evaluate an image prompt before generation.

prompt_templates.title: Commercial Use Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this proposed commercial use of [cultural element] from [community]. Evaluate consent, attribution, community benefit, legal concerns, and safer partnership options.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team is considering cultural material for a product or campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Framework-Based Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [content set] using CARE, OCAP, UNDRIP, and Local Contexts principles. Build a risk matrix and separate verified facts from unresolved consent questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced reviewer needs a structured assessment across several items.

output_examples.input: Review a prompt requesting a generic tribal warrior with mixed ceremonial symbols.
output_examples.output: Decision: Refuse. The prompt combines unrelated cultures and treats ceremonial symbols as decoration. Name a specific community and use documented, nonrestricted elements.

output_examples.input: Review an article about current Bunun music education using public sources.
output_examples.output: Decision: Pass with attribution. The article names the community, uses current context, and cites public material. Add an AI-generated content disclosure.

output_examples.input: Review packaging that copies a Paiwan pattern without documented permission.
output_examples.output: Decision: Revise before use. Confirm the rights holder, seek community consent, document attribution, and establish a benefit-sharing arrangement.

best_practices: Name the specific nation or community and verify terminology through community-authored sources.
Separate public cultural information from sacred, seasonal, gender-restricted, or otherwise controlled knowledge.
Seek community consent and legal advice before commercial use of traditional cultural expressions.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated traditions into a generic Indigenous style.
Do not treat public online access as evidence of permission or unrestricted use.
Do not present this review as community approval, legal authorization, or cultural expertise.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal approval?
faq.answer: No. It identifies concerns but does not replace legal advice, rights clearance, or community authorization.

faq.question: Can it review both text and image prompts?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews written content, image prompts, and descriptions of existing images.

faq.question: Does a passed review mean a community approved the content?
faq.answer: No. A pass only means the supplied material avoided identified red flags.

faq.question: What happens when the community is not named?
faq.answer: The skill requests a specific community because broad labels often produce inaccurate cultural mixtures.

faq.question: How does it handle sacred or restricted knowledge?
faq.answer: It treats uncertain restrictions conservatively and recommends consultation with the relevant community.

faq.question: Is the skill limited to Indigenous peoples in Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. Its framework is global, but its detailed community list and legal references focus on Taiwan.
